name: Costume Rape ~Seido Kaichou wa Ore Senzoku no Onapet Cosplayer~
original_name: コスチューム・レイプ～生奴会長はオレ専属のオナペットコスプレイヤー～
source:
Kuroro Karasuyama was your average gloomy kid in the anime club. At one event, he spotted Reiko Nishikiori, the student council president who always mocked him, dressed up in cosplay.
He snapped a photo. Turns out, Reiko was not just a closet otaku-she was a cosplayer too.
Kuroro used shots where Reiko's areola or pubes peeked out of her costume to blackmail her, calling her out for "private shoots" and raping her.
With more and more dirt piling up on her, Reiko had no choice but to do whatever Kuroro said, day after day getting violated in all kinds of cosplay outfits.
One day, as usual, he had Reiko dressed up and was abusing her in the anime clubroom when Midori Kirisawa, a younger club member, walked in on them.
But instead of keeping quiet, Kuroro raped Midori too, and took pictures for insurance.
With their secrets held over them and the abuse never stopping, both girls eventually started to feel pleasure from it all.
And so today again, a new costume gets soaked in white as another filthy photoshoot begins...

translation:
乌山黑郎是动画同好会里一个普通而阴沉的少年。某次活动中，他看见总是嘲笑自己的学生会长锦织玲子身穿角色扮演服装。
他立刻拍下照片。原来，玲子不仅是隐藏身份的御宅族，还是一名角色扮演者。
黑郎利用玲子穿角色扮演服时露出乳晕或阴毛的照片威胁她，以“私人摄影”为名把她叫出来强暴。
落在他手中的把柄越来越多，玲子别无选择，只能听从黑郎的一切命令，日复一日穿着不同角色服装遭到侵犯。
某天，黑郎像往常一样，让玲子换好服装后在动画同好会活动室凌辱她，却被低年级社员桐泽绿撞见。
黑郎没有要求她保密，而是连绿也一并强暴，再拍下照片作为保险。
秘密被人牢牢掌握，侵犯又永无休止，两名少女最终都开始从中感到快感。
于是今天，又有一套崭新服装被染成白色，另一场淫秽摄影会就此开始……
